Portable XPS Analyzer

v1.11

XPS spectrum analysis in the browser: reading (VGD · VAMAS · Avantage xls/xlsx/avg · text), background, peak fitting with uncertainties, quantification, survey identification, charge correction, series · ARXPS · imaging and processing tools.

Everything runs locally. Files you open are read by this page on your computer and are not uploaded anywhere. Work in progress is kept in this browser (IndexedDB); use Save work to keep a project file.

© 2026 WonJeong Yu, KAIST
Build 2026-11-04 · single-file edition of the XPS module of INNO Analytics

PXA in notes and menus = this program's own convention (as opposed to the CasaXPS or Avantage conventions it can reproduce).

Provided as is, without warranty. Check results against your own standards before relying on them.
